PASS on the fake backend only (gate exit 0; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run retriage-drivers-1-031) and unreviewed: driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null. No human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached, and no MuJoCo engine, Gym environment or robot run is claimed.

CARD AND SHAPE: the card's entry symbols were confirmed in the clone: trajopt.envs.reacher_env:Reacher7DOFEnv at trajopt/envs/reacher_env.py:8 and trajopt.envs.reacher_env:ContinualReacher7DOFEnv at :116; the card's model is trajopt/envs/assets/sawyer.xml:1. The card's helper is MujocoDriver, and this package uses it (no helper deviation). The two upstream symbols are Gym wrappers around mjrl.envs.mujoco_env.MujocoEnv; they import gym, mjrl and mujoco_py (reacher_env.py:1-4), setup.py does not list mjrl (setup.py:20-27), and none of those packages is installed where the gate runs. The driver therefore serves the shipped MJCF itself: cap.world.step.v1 writes data.ctrl after checking each element against the model's actuator_ctrlrange and calls mj_step; cap.world.reset.v1 calls mj_resetData + mj_forward. cap.world.seed.v1 is not served by MujocoBridge; reset accepts the class's seed field but mj_resetData does not use it. The upstream Gym wrapper's reward, declared observation (26) and done=False step are not part of the MuJoCo family contract and are NOT COVERED; the model's qpos/qvel/ctrl/time are served instead. The continual variant's moving target is also NOT COVERED.

LIMITS: the driver declares no Limit and no operator_required bound. The bridge derives action.ctrl from the model's actuator_ctrlrange: seven <motor> actuators, every one ctrllimited=true with ctrlrange -1.0..1.0 and gears 20/10 (sawyer.xml:101-109); the reference shows the seven per-element bounds with source upstream_code and ref trajopt/envs/assets/sawyer.xml:actuator_ctrlrange. Because every actuator is ranged, no site-limits.example.json is needed. The model's joint ranges are not control bounds and are not published as such.

FAKE: MuJoCo is not installed, so backends['fake'] is the package-local stand-in mujoco module .fake:FakeMujoco (a class object, as the MuJoCo family expects). It parses the pinned MJCF for nq/nv/nu, timestep, joint ranges and the seven ctrlranges, uses the model's gear, damping and armature, and integrates a placeholder torque model with a placeholder unit inertia. It loads no mesh, contact, friction, constraint, tendon or sensor, computes no site positions and has no full state API, so the bridge uses its basic checkpoint profile. All integration numbers the model does not state are marked placeholder in fake.py. The fake is an analytic stand-in, not a recording and not MuJoCo; it was not compared with MuJoCo or the upstream environment. The real path is the implicit sim backend (MujocoBridge imports mujoco) and requires the official engine plus the model file; it was not run and needs deployment validation before sim use. There is no hardware backend.

SAFETY: simulated R0 device (isolated simulated world stepping, MHS-004 SAFE-006 and catalog cap.world.step.v1). The runtime's software e-stop latch refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, while the integration state remains readable; this is not a hardware e-stop and makes no physical-safety claim. No estop_physical_ref is claimed. The state hash and checkpoint are simulation state, not hardware evidence.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') and adds eleven cases: model shape from the MJCF, every motor ctrlrange enforced before mutation, boundary values accepted, a step advancing time and joint positions, a step without an action, a short ctrl vector refused, a long step clamped at the model's pan joint range, reset to model defaults, snapshot/restore of the advertised state, the fake F0 and real F1 fidelity contracts, and the e-stop latch. All pass.

WARNINGS left by the last gate run, none failing: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND are the SDK's simulator-family warnings for a class-object backend; they do not mean this fake is the upstream simulator, and no native-call recording is claimed. G8.NO_UNIT x3 (ticks, action.ctrl[*], seed) are the expected bridge-derived MuJoCo inputs per PLAYBOOK.md section 8. No G4.REF_VALUE, G4.REF_BINARY or other G4 warning was raised.

No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. The clone at commit 23fbc453af2e980788348e5bde18136ad52378f0 was read only (G1 passed); no git command, network access, pip install or upstream execution was used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run. For the human reviewer: The package serves the MJCF model, not the Reacher7DOFEnv or ContinualReacher7DOFEnv task layers: rewards, target randomization/movement and the declared 26-D observation are excluded. Both entry classes were read; the continual subclass resets its target every 50 task steps (reacher_env.py:116-120). The software latch fences stepping but retains controls, so a later explicit step without a new ctrl vector can reuse them.
